NO_FAILURE.definition: The reviewed candidate SysML represents the selected source obligation and frozen architecture boundary without a visible static contract, decomposition, architecture, realization, or observation-interface fault in this run/chain pair. This label makes no claim about dynamic performance, formal proof, or physical verification.
include_when: all source and frozen-boundary obligations in the packet are represented in the candidate SysML
the required static observation interface and dependency are represented
no more specific failure class below is supported
exclude_when: the packet is valid but admissible evidence cannot decide a required non-static property
any contract, decomposition, realization, architecture, or observation fault is visible
NO_FAILURE._review: confirm that absence of visible failure is not treated as formal proof or physical verification

CONTRACT_INCOMPLETENESS.definition: The candidate contract omits or leaves ambiguous a required source obligation, assumption, guarantee, provenance binding, or safety-topology declaration.
include_when: a source obligation has no corresponding contract semantics
the contract is too incomplete to assess a component realization
exclude_when: the contract is complete but its behavior realization is missing or wrong
the approved decomposition is represented but incompatible or over budget
CONTRACT_INCOMPLETENESS._review: confirm separation from model realization and architecture design failures

INTEGRATION_DECOMPOSITION_GAP.definition: The selected component contracts do not form a closed approved decomposition because ownership, discharge, or required dependency edges are missing or inconsistent.
include_when: a guarantee has no unique approved owner
a non-environment assumption has no valid upstream discharge
the system obligation is not completely decomposed across the approved components
exclude_when: the decomposition is closed but a component behavior does not realize it
the decomposition is closed but its timing or compatibility is inadequate
INTEGRATION_DECOMPOSITION_GAP._review: confirm that the frozen architecture boundary, not runtime output, defines the approved decomposition

MODEL_SEMANTIC_FAULT.definition: The contract/decomposition intent and approved architecture are present, but the candidate SysML does not realize them through the required reachable trigger, transition, state, action, reset/relock path, or declared observation interface/dependency.
include_when: a required trigger, guard, entry action, reset, relock, or realization link is absent or wrong
a boundary-required observation interface or model dependency is absent or disconnected
exclude_when: the contract itself omits the obligation
the model faithfully represents the approved architecture but that architecture's unit, compatibility, or additive composition is inadequate
the observation interface is present but admissible evidence cannot establish a non-static outcome
MODEL_SEMANTIC_FAULT._review: confirm that this class concerns committed SysML semantics, not checker implementation

ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN_ISSUE.definition: The candidate faithfully represents the frozen architecture, but the represented architecture violates an approved unit, compatibility, additive timing-budget, or composition constraint independently of any missing SysML realization element.
include_when: required timing segments are absent or their additive budget exceeds the deadline
component guarantees and assumptions are semantically incompatible
the design defect remains after assuming every required model realization element is present and correctly connected
exclude_when: the frozen architecture is adequate but the candidate model fails to realize it
the candidate diverges from the frozen architecture rather than faithfully representing it
the evidence is insufficient to distinguish a design issue
ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN_ISSUE._review: confirm that this class does not authorize automatic semantic repair or design-space decisions

VERIFIER_LIMITATION.definition: The structurally valid blind packet contains the source, frozen architecture boundary, and candidate model, but those permitted materials cannot decide a required non-static property without additional independent evidence. This class is not used for a missing model observation interface or another visible model defect.
include_when: the model contains the boundary-required observation interface, but the permitted material cannot establish the observed dynamic or physical outcome
the packet is structurally valid and no visible static defect supports another class, yet a defensible substantive conclusion still requires evidence outside the permitted material
exclude_when: a more specific source, contract, decomposition, realization, architecture, or missing-observation-interface failure is directly visible
the packet itself is invalid or missing its frozen architecture boundary; that is a readiness-gate failure, not a run label
VERIFIER_LIMITATION._review: confirm this is the sole inconclusive class and is not used to hide a visible model fault

adjudication.multi_fault_rule: Choose one most-upstream root cause directly supported by the allowed blind material: CONTRACT_INCOMPLETENESS, then INTEGRATION_DECOMPOSITION_GAP. Between ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN_ISSUE and MODEL_SEMANTIC_FAULT, choose ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN_ISSUE only when the candidate faithfully represents the frozen boundary and the unit/compatibility/additive-composition defect remains with all required realization elements present; otherwise choose MODEL_SEMANTIC_FAULT for a missing or wrong realization or observation-interface element. Use VERIFIER_LIMITATION only when no visible static defect supports another class and the valid packet cannot decide a required non-static property. Use NO_FAILURE only for absence of visible static faults, never as formal or physical validation.
adjudication._review: confirm the explicit architecture-versus-model tie-break and the distinction between a missing model observation interface (MODEL_SEMANTIC_FAULT) and unavailable non-static evidence (VERIFIER_LIMITATION) before the first label is authored

review_instructions: This is an AI-assisted candidate taxonomy, not evaluator authority. Reviewers receive the exact source requirement, independently frozen architecture boundary, and candidate model, but no runtime verdict, checker diagnostics, classification, or repair trace. Independently confirm or edit every definition, inclusion/exclusion rule, and adjudication rule; remove all _review markers; set a named reviewer and ISO date; set independent_human_review=true; change status to FROZEN; then compute artifact_digest with evaluation_readiness.artifact_digest.
